EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 402 September 14, 1972
TO INCLUDE AN ADDITIONAL MEMBER TO THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE OF THE NATIONAL
SECURITY COUNCIL
Pursuant to the powers vested in me by law, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do
hereby increase the membership of the Executive Committee of the National Security Council as embodied in
Executive Order No. 13 dated February 24, 1966 and reconstituted under Executive Order No. 396 dated June
19, 1972, to include the Secretary of Education as an additional member.
Done in the City of Manila, this 14th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-two.
